description: Bring the connected QuickBooks Online company's products, vendors (as suppliers) and customers into Spark as records, and optionally QuickBooks' on-hand quantities as opening stock. Requires the governed two-step protocol. Call it with preview=true first (the default): it reads QuickBooks and reports what would be matched, created or skipped, writing nothing, and returns a single-use previewReceipt. Show the person those counts and ask; once they agree, repeat the identical call with that previewReceipt and a fresh idempotencyKey to import. The receipt covers the QuickBooks records the preview read: if QuickBooks changes before the import, the import is refused with PREVIEW_RECEIPT_REJECTED and nothing is written; preview again and show the new counts. preview=false without a receipt is refused with PREVIEW_RECEIPT_REQUIRED. Products match Spark items by Spark's link, then SKU, then name; matched records keep their values and only blanks are filled. With createUnmatchedItems=false nothing new is created (use it when a store such as Shopify is the catalog). openingStock sets Spark's quantity to QuickBooks' (zero included) at the Internal warehouse, or warehouseId when there are several; it replaces the current on-hand. Safe to run again: it matches what it brought in before. Run it before the QuickBooks sales and purchase backfills so history lands on these items. Refused on a 3PL account and without a working QuickBooks connection. Requires an operator (unpinned) write credential with imports.execute, and an admin.

createUnmatchedItems.description: With items: also create a Spark item for each QuickBooks product that matches none. False only links products to existing Spark items.

customers.description: QuickBooks customers. Store pseudo-customers and sub-customers are skipped.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to import. A retry with the same key returns the first import's result without importing again.

openingStock.description: Set Spark's on-hand to QuickBooks' quantity for the products QuickBooks tracks.

preview.description: True (default) reports what would happen, writes nothing and returns a previewReceipt. The import itself needs previewReceipt and idempotencyKey.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt the preview returned. Supply it with a fresh idempotencyKey and the same arguments to import.

vendors.description: QuickBooks vendors, as Spark suppliers with email, phone and payment terms.

warehouseId.description: With openingStock: the Internal warehouse to set stock at (from list_warehouses). Needed only when the account has several.

name: import_qbo_master_data
title: Import QuickBooks Master Data
